title: Device-Config State-Machine Spec (engine #2)
description: Declarative spec for the device-config state-machine engine (engine #2, ledger §E / F5). Models a simulated device the learner programs: declared `screens` and `fields` define the valid state space, and `assertion_rules` express what a correct configuration must satisfy (e.g. 'partition entry delay > 0', 'smoke zone = 24-hour fire', 'front-door camera reassigned first'). Each rule is tagged with a §5.4 dimension and an optional safety_flag so a failed safety rule routes through the shared safety-veto hook (ledger §B). The runtime replays a SANITIZED recorded fixture (faithful interactive replica, never a live API) referenced via the envelope. engine_kind is pinned to 'device_config' (academy.sim_kind).

$schema.description: Optional editor/CI hint pointing at this schema's $id.

envelope.description: Shared sim envelope. engine_kind MUST be 'device_config'. Replay engines normally set envelope.fixture_set_ref to a sanitized fixture set.

device.description: What device this spec simulates (for the learner's context + accuracy audit).

source_citation.description: Datasheet / source reference for the accuracy audit (wave4 §3.6c).

screens.description: Ordered device screens the learner navigates. Each screen references a fixture image (replay) and the fields visible on it.

fields.description: The configurable fields across all screens — the declarative state space. Keyed by field id; the learner's writes to these compose the device state the assertion rules evaluate.

assertion_rules.description: The correctness rules evaluated against the final (or stepwise) device state. Each is §5.4-tagged; safety_flag rules veto on failure.

fixture_image_r2_key.description: R2 key for the sanitized recorded screenshot this screen replays. Resolved against the fixture_set manifest.

field_ids.description: Which fields appear on this screen (keys of `fields`).

field.title: configurable field
field.description: One device setting. type + constraints define its slice of the valid state space.

options.description: For type=enum: the allowed option values + their i18n labels.

required_field.description: Whether the learner must set this field.

assertionRule.title: assertion rule
assertionRule.description: A correctness predicate over device state. `expr` is a restricted, deterministic predicate language (field refs, comparison + boolean ops, and ordering predicates like reassigned_before(a,b)) — NO arbitrary code, NO network. The engine evaluates it and the shared Verdict service scores it. A failed safety_flag rule trips the veto hook.

description_i18n.description: Human statement of the rule (e.g. 'Partition 1 entry delay must be greater than 0 s').

expr.description: Deterministic predicate. Grammar (whitelist): field('id'), literals, ==, !=, >, <, >=, <=, &&, ||, !, and the ordering helpers reassigned_before('a','b') / set_before('a','b'). Evaluated by the engine's rule interpreter only.

safety_flag.description: True if violating this rule is a SAFETY-CRITICAL failure (e.g. a smoke zone not set to 24-hour fire, an egress door's lock set fail-locked). Failure routes through the safety-veto hook → forces fail + safety_veto_triggered (ledger §B).

fail_feedback_i18n.description: Instant, specific, diagnostic feedback when the rule is violated — names the real-world consequence + the fix.

allOf.$comment: A safety_flag rule must score into the safety_compliance dimension so the >=90% safety bar + veto engage consistently.
